entries.name: ScreenCaptureKit
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screenshot.rs; springboard/ui/src/capture_content.rs; springboard/ui/src/capture_picker.rs; springboard/ui/src/capture_access.rs; springboard/ui/src/capture_shot.rs; springboard/ui/src/capture_stream.rs; springboard/shell/services/screen_stream.rs; springboard/sdk/src/screen_stream.rs; springboard/ui/src/capture_stream.rs; springboard/src/shell/services/screen_stream.rs; springboard/sdk/src/screen_stream.rs; springboard/ui/src/capture_filter.rs; springboard/sdk/src/screen_stream.rs; springboard/src/shell/services/screen_stream.rs
entries.note: Pure models exist for shareable content, the content-sharing picker, capture permission and single-frame screenshots, and the shell's screenshot chord saves frames. Built 2026-10-17: pure frame pacer ScreenStream in springboard/ui/src/capture_stream.rs (permission gate, fresh and repeated frames, no catch-up bursts; tests capture_stream::tests). Built 2026-10-17: a permitted app starts a display stream through the screen_stream service (shell/services/screen_stream.rs); frames arrive as fresh or repeated PNG events (sdk/src/screen_stream.rs). Built 2026-10-17: the stream takes a content filter (one window, one app, or the display minus excluded apps) and an optional movie through the recorder encoder; the pointer is drawn into frames; a stream ends with its app; an idle shell reuses its presented picture (shell/services/screen_stream.rs, ui/src/capture_filter.rs, sdk/src/screen_stream.rs).
entries.ready_note: Display, window and app streams with a movie option, pointer, exit handling and presented-picture reuse are tested in the shell service, the content model and the SDK. Not yet run on Midget.

entries.ready_note: Apps declare [[intent]] tables in manifest.toml and serve them on their control socket. Search and the Shortcuts action library list and run an installed app's shortcut intents (shell::intents::runnable_shortcuts). Voice recognition is not built: nothing turns speech into an intent request, so Siri's spoken requests are not covered.
